rule-soft.purpose: Internal seams and secondary row rules.

signal.purpose: Only accent, decision pad, recommended state, focus outline.

label.purpose: Stamps, states, small metrics, and summaries.

evidence.purpose: Measurements, identifiers, run IDs, paths, route paths, and code.

plotLayout.fontFamily: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

components.name: Report Sheet
components.description: Single paper surface floating on the graticule field.
components.css: .ds-report-sheet { max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; background: var(--sheet); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--rule); box-shadow: 0 1px 1px #16181a0f, 0 26px 52px -30px #16181a5c; border-radius: 0; padding: clamp(20px, 4vw, 56px); }

components.name: Ruled Section Header
components.description: Ink rule with a signal division tick.
components.css: .ds-rule { position: relative; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); padding-top: 13px; margin-bottom: 18px; } .ds-rule::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 2px; height: 7px; background: var(--signal); } .ds-rule h2 { margin: 0; font: 600 1.0625rem/1.55 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

components.name: Divisional Readout
components.description: Counts on one ruled strip with vertical division ticks.
components.css: .ds-readout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(132px, 1fr)); border-top: 1px solid var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); } .ds-division { position: relative; padding: 15px 16px 15px 15px; border-left: 1px solid var(--rule-soft); } .ds-division:first-child { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; } .ds-division::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: -1px; width: 1px; height: 6px; background: var(--ink); } .ds-v { display: block; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 1.375rem; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-k { display: block; margin-top: 7px; font-size: 10.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.09em; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: State Chip
components.description: Uppercase mono word plus square mark.
components.css: .ds-state { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-state::before { content: ""; width: 8px; height: 8px; flex: 0 0 auto; } .ds-state-rec { color: var(--signal); } .ds-state-rec::before { background: var(--signal); } .ds-state-hold { color: var(--hold); } .ds-state-hold::before { border: 1.5px solid var(--hold); }

components.name: Evidence Table
components.description: Ruled table with captions, scoped headers, ARIA roles, and labelled narrow cells.
components.html:
Evidence
Metric
100%
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13.5px; } .ds-table caption { caption-side: top; text-align: left; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); padding-bottom: 12px; max-width: 72ch; } .ds-table th { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--muted); text-align: left; padding: 0 14px 8px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); } .ds-table td { padding: 11px 14px 11px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-soft); font-family: var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Details Disclosure
components.description: Native disclosure with the only authored motion in the report.
components.css: .ds-summary { cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 6px 0; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.09em; color: var(--muted); list-style: none; } .ds-summary::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-right: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-bottom: 1.5px solid currentColor; transform: rotate(-45deg); transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1); margin-bottom: 2px; } details[open] > .ds-summary::before { transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-summary:hover { color: var(--ink); } .ds-summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: API Route Row
components.description: Ruled route entry with method, path, and muted description.
components.html: GET/hardwareList supported hardware profiles.
components.css: .ds-endpoint { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 4.25rem) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 2px 18px; padding: 13px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-soft); } .ds-method { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10.5px; letter-spacing: 0.09em; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--signal); } .ds-path { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 0.9375rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-about { grid-column: 2; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.875rem; }

components.name: Report Ornament
components.description: Diagram scale trace motif for empty groups or final terminus.
components.html: <svg class="ds-ornament" viewBox="0 0 160 32" aria-hidden="true"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor"><path d="M0 6H72L88 14H120" stroke-width="2.5"/><path d="M0 26H72L88 18H120" stroke-width="1.25"/><rect x="119.75" y="6.75" width="18.5" height="18.5" stroke-width="1.5"/></g></svg>
components.css: .ds-ornament { display: block; width: 232px; height: auto; color: var(--ink); opacity: 0.3; margin: 26px 0 0; }

narrative.overview:
LLMTraceFX records evidence for local LLM and GPU inference work. The visual system must therefore read as measurement, not as promotion. The built world is a laboratory sheet over a bone coloured field. A faint graticule sits behind a paper sheet, data is set in monospace with tabular figures, and structure is made from hairline rules rather than cards.

The primary surface is `llmtracefx/optimizer/tune/report_html.py`, where `DIRECTION_CONTRACT` names the world: oscilloscope graticule and measurement cursors, seed `3bd5d052`. The report is a static audit artifact. It opens from disk, carries all evidence in one HTML file, and keeps accepted, rejected, inconclusive, and excluded material visible. The secondary shell in `llmtracefx/visualize/flame.py` reuses the same field, sheet, lockup, ruled readout, and Plotly theme. The API index in `llmtracefx/api/serve.py` uses the same grammar for a compact route list.
keyCharacteristics: Bone field with a 48px graticule behind a lighter paper sheet.
Near black ink, grey mute, translucent hairlines, and exactly one authored accent hue.
System type only: sans for prose, mono for evidence, route paths, identifiers, metrics, and stamps.
Zero radius on sheets, tables, state marks, pads, and route rows.
Status is a word plus a mark, never colour alone.
Offline tune reports have no JavaScript, no web fonts, no external images, and no CDN references.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Use `--signal` as the only accent hue. Do not add purple AI gradients, neon cyberpunk colours, glass tints, or a second callout hue.

rules.name: The Null Reading Rule
rules.body: Inconclusive states use `--hold`, a graphite colour, because refusing to guess is a null reading rather than a warning.

rules.name: The Tested Contrast Rule
rules.body: Text colours must keep the measured contrast ratios above. The chart sequence is covered by `tests/test_brand_assets.py::test_every_series_colour_carries_a_readable_label`, which requires every series colour to hold white text and sheet contrast.

rules.name: The Evidence Mono Rule
rules.body: Every identifier, artifact path, metric, route path, candidate label, and cursor reading uses `--mono` with tabular figures where numbers are compared.

rules.name: The System Type Rule
rules.body: Do not fetch web fonts. The offline report rule and `tests/test_brand_assets.py::test_token_block_fetches_no_fonts` require system stacks only.

rules.name: The Ruled Not Carded Rule
rules.body: Use hairline borders, table rules, division ticks, and sheet lift. Do not wrap every statistic or table in separate cards.

rules.name: The No Paint Gradient Rule
rules.body: Gradients are structural only: graticules and excluded-run diagonal ruling. Do not use gradients as brand paint.

rules.name: The Zero Radius Rule
rules.body: Do not add rounded corners. A radius would contradict the measurement sheet, decision pad, route geometry, and test-backed mark system.

dos: Do use `llmtracefx/brand.py` as the single source of truth for tokens, inline marks, chart sequence, heatmap scale, and Plotly layout.
Do keep the report in the oscilloscope and logic analyzer measurement sheet world recorded in `DIRECTION_CONTRACT`.
Do use the 48px graticule on the field and the paper sheet on top of it.
Do use mono with tabular figures for all evidence, identifiers, paths, routes, metrics, stamps, and cursor readings.
Do keep rejected, inconclusive, excluded, and provenance material visible and labelled.
Do preserve explicit ARIA table roles and `data-label` attributes on any table that reflows at `max-width: 760px`.
Do pair every status colour with an uppercase word or visible label.
Do use native `<details>` for disclosure in the offline report.
Do use the primary lockup on light sheets, the inverse lockup on dark grounds, mono lockups for one colour reproduction, and the icon only at favicon scale.
Do keep report output deterministic, escaped, path redacted by default, and free of network references.
donts: Don't add rounded corners, pill chips, card stacks, glass effects, or paint gradients.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or generic AI purple.
Don't fetch fonts or assets in the tune report.
Don't add JavaScript to the tune report. The only interaction is native disclosure.
Don't encode status by colour alone.
Don't add `xmlns` to inline report SVG constants, because that introduces a forbidden `http://` string.
Don't clip candidate labels, run IDs, paths, or metric cells. Wrap them and provide labels on narrow screens.
Don't use the diagram ornament as filler decoration. Use open for no decision and filled for a completed sheet terminus.
